vocabulary.meaning_en: a formal investigation; (US) also any question
vocabulary.note_ar: في أمريكا تُستخدم لكل شيء، وفي بريطانيا للتحقيقات الرسمية
vocabulary.note_en: US: for everything. UK: for formal investigations.
vocabulary.example: The government started an inquiry into the accident.

vocabulary.meaning_en: (British) a general question; asking for information
vocabulary.example: I have an enquiry about the train times.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a careful official search for the facts
vocabulary.example: The police investigation took two months.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to be sure of something because of facts, proof and checking
vocabulary.example: We know that water boils at 100 degrees.

vocabulary.meaning_en: facts that show something is true
checking by others that something is true
vocabulary.example: Scientists need verification from other labs.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something you think is true, often from personal experience
vocabulary.example: It's my belief that hard work pays off.

vocabulary.meaning_en: strong trust in something or someone without needing direct physical proof
vocabulary.note_en: have faith in someone or something
vocabulary.example: I have faith in my team.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to mix two different ideas together as if they were the same
a local place where people are kept for a short time, for minor crimes or before trial
vocabulary.example: He spent one night in jail.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a place where people stay for a long time for serious crimes
vocabulary.example: He was sent to prison for twenty years.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to keep delaying something you should do now
vocabulary.example: Stop procrastinating and start your homework.
I put off the dishes until tomorrow.

vocabulary.meaning_en: not wanting to work or make any effort
vocabulary.example: He is too lazy to clean his room.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to have something in your memory easily, without effort
vocabulary.example: I remember my mother's phone number.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to bring something back to memory with effort
vocabulary.note_ar: يكثر في المحاكم: Do you recall...?
vocabulary.note_en: Common in court: Do you recall...?
vocabulary.example: I can't recall what happened that evening.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to talk a lot without saying anything important

fine_lines.title: inquiry vs enquiry
fine_lines.explanation_ar: في أمريكا: inquiry لكل شيء. في بريطانيا: inquiry للتحقيق الرسمي (حكومة، شرطة، محكمة)، وenquiry للسؤال العادي.
fine_lines.explanation_en: US: inquiry for everything. UK: inquiry for formal investigations, enquiry for everyday questions.

examples.sentence: There will be a public inquiry into the fire.
Thank you for your enquiry about our prices.

fine_lines.title: know vs belief vs faith
fine_lines.explanation_ar: know: تعرف بالحقائق والدليل والتحقق من الآخرين. belief: قناعة شخصية من تجربتك، بدليل محدود. faith: ثقة قوية وأمل دون حاجة لدليل مادي مباشر.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Know: facts, proof and checking by others. Belief: from your own experience, with limited proof. Faith: strong trust and hope without direct physical evidence.

examples.sentence: I know the earth goes around the sun.
It's my belief that this shop is the best.
She has faith that things will get better.

fine_lines.title: jail vs prison
fine_lines.explanation_ar: jail مكان مؤقت لجرائم صغيرة أو لليلة واحدة (J = just now). prison لمدة طويلة لجرائم خطيرة (P = permanent).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Jail: short-term, minor crimes (J = just now). Prison: long-term, serious crimes (P = permanent).

examples.sentence: They kept him in jail for the night.
The robber went to prison for ten years.

fine_lines.title: procrastinate vs lazy
fine_lines.explanation_ar: procrastinate: تريد أن تعمل لكنك تؤجّل الآن إلى وقت لاحق. lazy: لا تريد أن تعمل أبدًا، وهي عادة طويلة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Procrastinate: you will do it, but later, not now. Lazy: you don't want to work at all; it's a long-term habit.

examples.sentence: I'm watching videos because I'm procrastinating.
He's lazy; he never helps at home.

fine_lines.title: remember vs recall
fine_lines.explanation_ar: remember: الشيء في ذاكرتك بسهولة دون جهد. recall: تحتاج جهدًا للبحث في ذاكرتك.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Remember: it's in your memory easily. Recall: you need effort to search your memory.

examples.sentence: Let me think. I can't recall his name.

expressions.example: Do you recall where you were that night?

expressions.meaning_en: I can't bring it back to memory.
expressions.example: I'm sorry, I don't recall his name.
Don't put it off until later; do it now.
